description: The targets each UK build calibrates to (microcosm#1759): the level rule that places every compiled UK target at one geography level, and the full build's selection of its solve surface by level. microcosm.calibrate.target_sets reads this file; microcosm.build.uk_runtime.target_sets names its products. The US declares its target sets the same way, in us/target_sets.json (microcosm#1728).

level_rule.rationale: A compiled UK target names its level in its local metadata (geography_level), in the Ledger's (ledger_geography_level), or in both. Both must then agree, and the level must be one of the five grains a UK build calibrates at; any other target is refused, not placed by a guess. This is the rule the UK resolver uk_runtime.graph_targets.target_geography applied in code before microcosm#1759.

levels.description: The full (local-line) build's solve surface: the compiled targets of the levels the build requests, all of them by default, in compile order, with a receipt that lists every target (uk.full.target_selection@1). The node first applies the build's family filter (--households-only) and, with no area BRMAs, drops the brma rows.

compiled.rationale: The country-level rows. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The region-level rows. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The Westminster constituency cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.
The local-authority cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset.

The Broad Rental Market Area cells. Kept when the build requests this level; a build requests every level unless --target-geographies names a subset. With no area BRMAs (--brma-localisation none) the node drops these rows before it selects, because they would bind on the spine's regional BRMA draw (microcosm#1305).
